blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — A 65-year-old American citizen was found dead inside his rented apartment in Barangay Washington, Surigao City, on Saturday, Oct. 10, police confirmed on Monday. Lt. Col. Mariano Lukban, Surigao City police director, withheld the identity of the victim, a married male native of Florida, pending notification of his next of kin and the United States Embassy. He said that initial investigations showed the American checked into the apartment unit along Mariposa Street, Purok Orchids, on Oct. 5.
